ideas.title: Food Managment
ideas.content:
Trigger: An order is canceled while the item is already prepared or the rider is in transit.

Geofencing: The app identifies active users within a specific radius (e.g., 1–2km) of the item's current location.

The Offer: A high-urgency popup appears for those users: "Flash Deal! A fresh [Item] is nearby. Grab it in the next 5 minutes for 40% off!"

ideas.title: Cancelled Packs
